reset_mail.subject: {{game}}: choose a new password

Hello {{name}},

Someone (you, most likely) asked to change the password of your {{game}} account.
To choose a new one, open this link (valid for {{minutes}} minutes):

{{link}}

If you did not ask for anything, ignore this message: your password stays the same.

options.touch_help: Touch screen: joystick to move, A to act (talk, open, attack in front), B to go back or open the menu. The buttons in an arc around A use the shortcuts (1-4 / 5-8 switches the page). Tap a cell to walk there, a monster or a player to target it.

Windows: I bag, C character, U equipment, K skills, J quests, L friends, G guild, P party, M map, O options. Mouse: click a cell to walk there, a monster or a player to target it.

help.title: Shortcuts and gestures
help.save: Ctrl+S: save the map (players on it see it at once).
help.clipboard: Ctrl+X / Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V: cut, copy, paste the selection, or the event chosen in Events mode. Pasting goes under the pointer (from the toolbar: at the selection or the last cell clicked).
help.delete: Del: clear the selection, or delete the chosen event.
help.tools: P, R, E, F, I, G, S: pencil, rectangle, ellipse, fill, eyedropper, eraser, select.
help.picker: Right click on the map: take the tile under the pointer (eyedropper).
help.shadow: Shadow pen: each click adds or removes the shadow of a quarter of a cell.
help.palette: Palette: drag to take several tiles at once; tab R holds the regions.
help.layer: Layer: "Auto layer" puts each tile on the right layer; a forced layer allows fine control.
help.events: Events mode: click to choose, drag to move, double click (or Enter) to create or edit an event.
help.passage: Passability mode: click (or drag) to block or unblock cells, without touching their tiles.
help.playtest: Test the map: back to the game on the edited map, at the last cell clicked.
help.touch_fab: Round button at the bottom right: the hand (your finger moves the map) or drawing (your finger paints). The map has a yellow frame while drawing, a blue one with the hand.
help.touch_two: Two fingers: move the map and pinch to zoom, in every mode. The zoom is remembered on this device.
help.touch_long: Long press: in Events mode, create or edit the event of the cell; in Tiles mode, pick the tile under the finger.
help.touch_events: Events mode: a tap chooses an event and dragging it moves it (a dashed frame shows where it lands); dragging elsewhere moves the map.
help.touch_passage: Passability mode: a tap blocks or unblocks the cell, even with the hand.
help.touch_drawers: “Maps” and “Palette” buttons: open the list of maps or the tiles; the palette closes once the tiles are chosen.
help.touch_save: Above the round button: undo, redo and save. A yellow dot on save means there are unsaved changes; after saving, the hand comes back.

editor.event_discard_confirm: Close without saving? The changes made to this event will be lost.

loop.label: Looping map
loop.help: Looping map: leaving by an edge comes back by the opposite one, without loading (world map, endless sea…). Near an edge, what lies beyond is already visible.

legend.passage: Passability — ○ walkable · × obstacle · ☆ drawn above characters · ◇ passable in some directions only · framed cell: set by hand (a click blocks or unblocks).
legend.region: Regions — each number colours the cells of an area (monster spawns, events…). Choose a number in the palette, then paint.
legend.shadow: Shadows — a click darkens a quarter of a cell (at the foot of a wall, for instance) or lightens it when it was dark; dragging does the same over several quarters.
legend.events: Events — double-click a cell: create or edit its event (quick forms for an NPC, a chest, a teleporter… or the full editor). Drag an event to move it.

fab.panning: Hand on: your finger moves the map. Tap to draw.
fab.drawing: Drawing on: your finger paints the map. Tap to move the map instead.
fab.editing: Editing: your finger changes events or cells. Tap to move the map instead.

legend_touch.passage: Passability — ○ walkable · × obstacle · ☆ above characters · ◇ some directions only · framed cell: set by hand. A tap blocks or unblocks a cell.
legend_touch.region: Regions — choose a number in the Palette, then paint the cells of the area (monster spawns, events…).
legend_touch.shadow: Shadows — a tap darkens a quarter of a cell or lightens it; dragging does the same over several quarters.
legend_touch.events: Events — long press a cell: create or edit its event. Drag an event to move it.

help.outfit: Outfit style shown on the character creation page for this class.
help.defaultAppearance: Appearance offered by default (body, skin, hair, colors) when a player picks this class.
help.class_params: Class stats: value at level 1 and gain per level. Click a curve to adjust it.
help.expBase: Experience needed to go from level 1 to level 2.
help.expGrowth: Each level needs this percentage more experience than the previous one (20 = +20%).
help.learnings: Skills learned automatically on reaching a level.
help.weaponTypes: Weapon types this class may equip (tick them; none ticked = all).
help.armorTypes: Armor types this class may wear (tick them; none ticked = all).
help.traits: Permanent effects: bonuses or penalties applied while the class, equipment or state is in place.
help.traits_kind: What the trait changes: stats, regeneration, resistances, attacks, skills given, or experience and gold gains.
help.effects: What happens when the skill or item hits its target.
help.effects_kind: Heal HP or MP, add or remove a state, give experience, teach a skill, or run a common event.
help.damage: Damage or healing done to the target. Leave the type on "None" for a skill without damage.
help.damage_type: Kind of result: damage or healing, on HP or MP.
help.damage_formula: Example: a.atk * 4 - b.def * 2. "a" is the user, "b" the target; values: mhp, mmp, atk, def, mat, mdf, agi, luk, hp, mp, level.
help.damage_element: Element of the attack (list of the System tab): targets weak or resistant to it change the damage.
help.damage_variance: Damage varies randomly by ± this percentage (20 = from −20% to +20%).
help.damage_critical: Allows critical hits with this attack.
help.cooldown: Delay before the skill can be used again.
help.skill_range: Maximum distance, in tiles, between the caster and the target.
help.weapon_range: Attack distance of the weapon, in tiles (1 = melee).
help.area: Radius, in tiles, hit around the target (0 = a single target).
help.scope: Who can be targeted: oneself, an enemy, an ally, or everyone in an area around the target.
help.animationId: Animation played on the target (see the Animations tab).
help.message: Text shown in the chat when the skill is used (optional).
help.item_kind: Regular: can be sold and traded. Key or Quest: stays with its owner (no selling or trading).
help.price: Purchase price at merchants; reselling gives a percentage of it (see System).
help.consumable: If checked, the item is used up.
help.occasion: Where the item can be used: always, in battle, in the menu, or never.
help.weaponType: Weapon category (list of the System tab): a class can only equip the categories it is allowed.
help.armorType: Armor category (list of the System tab): a class can only wear the categories it is allowed.
help.slot: Equipment slot taken by this armor.
help.params: Stat bonuses granted (added to the character’s).
help.characterName: Image holding the characters: one sheet holds up to 8 (preview below).
help.characterIndex: Which character to take from the sheet: from 0 (top left) to 7 (bottom right). No effect on a "single character" sheet.
help.exp: Experience earned by the player who kills this monster.
help.gold: Money earned by killing this monster.
help.drops: Items the monster may leave when it dies.
help.drops_kind: Loot category: item, weapon or armor.
help.drops_chance: Chance of leaving this loot (100 = always).
help.ai: Passive: only attacks when hit. Aggressive: attacks any player who comes close. Coward: attacks on sight but flees when hurt.
help.aggroRadius: Distance, in tiles, from which an aggressive or coward monster notices a player.
help.actions: Skills the monster uses in combat, besides its normal attack, each under a condition (always, low HP, state, switch).
help.actions_weight: Draw weight: the higher it is, the more often the skill is chosen (the normal attack has a weight of 5).
help.respawn: Delay before the monster reappears after dying.
help.moveSpeed: Movement speed, from 1 (very slow) to 6 (very fast).
help.state_duration: Duration of the state in seconds; 0 = lasts until removed.
help.restriction: What the state prevents: moving, acting (attacking, using a skill), or both.
help.hpPerSecond: Percentage of max HP gained every second (negative: lost, like poison).
help.mpPerSecond: Percentage of max MP gained every second (negative: lost).
help.removeOnDamage: If checked, the state ends as soon as the target takes damage (like sleep).
help.sheet: Animation image: the frames are placed side by side.
help.frameCount: Number of frames in the sheet.
help.frameSize: Width (and height) of one frame, in pixels.
help.trigger: None: started by an event command. Autorun: runs by itself, blocking the player, while the switch is on. Parallel: runs by itself without blocking.
help.commonEvent_switchId: Switch (Switches and variables tab) that activates the autorun or parallel event; “None”: always active.
help.category: Chapter or chain: groups quests in the journal.
help.quest_level: Recommended minimum level for the quest.
help.prerequisite: Quest to finish before this one can be taken.
help.autoComplete: If checked, the quest ends with its last step, with no need to go back to the quest giver.
help.takeItems: If checked, the collected items are taken from the bag when the quest ends.
help.steps: Steps in order: all the objectives of a step must be met to move to the next.
help.objectives: What the player must do in this step.
help.objectives_kind: Talk to a character, reach a place, kill monsters, gather items, or turn a switch on.
help.objectives_switchId: Switch to turn on (by an event) to complete the objective.
help.cell: Click "Choose" to pick the tile on the map.
help.objectives_radius: Distance, in tiles, at which the place counts as reached.
help.label: Text shown in the journal instead of the automatic description.
help.sellRate: Percentage of the price a merchant pays when a player sells an item back.
help.statPointsPerLevel: Stat points the player distributes at each level.
help.maxPartySize: Maximum number of players in a party.
help.maxRaidSize: Maximum number of players in a raid (enlarged party).
help.instanceIdleMinutes: An empty instance is closed after this many minutes.
help.startPosition: Where new characters appear: map and tile.
help.bossEnemyId: Monster acting as this raid’s boss.
help.minPlayers: Minimum number of players to enter.
help.lockout: How often a player can get the reward: weekly, daily, or every time.
help.lootMode: Loot sharing: in turn, or everyone rolls the dice for an item.
help.phases: Fight phases: each one starts when the boss drops below a percentage of HP.
help.hpBelow: The phase starts when the boss’s HP drop below this percentage.
help.mechanic: Summoning enemies or a damaging ground zone.
help.phases_radius: Radius of the zone, in tiles.
help.class_start: Where new characters of this class appear (and where they go back with “Send back to start” or when they have no respawn point). Choose the map, then “Pick on the map” and click the cell.
help.state_message: Text shown to the player when the state hits them, after the character’s name (e.g. “is poisoned!”).
help.effects_amount: Healing: HP or MP restored on top of the percentage. Experience: points given.
help.effects_state: State added or removed (see the States tab; its duration is set there).
help.effects_commonEvent: Common event run for the player hit.
help.effects_maxPercent: Percentage of max HP or MP restored, added to the amount.
help.effects_chance: Success chance in %. Adding: reduced by the target’s resistance to this state.
help.traits_param: Stat multiplied (names of the Terms tab).
help.traits_element: Element concerned (list of the System tab).
help.traits_state: State the target resists, or that its normal attacks inflict.
help.traits_rate: Multiplier: 1 = unchanged, 0.5 = half, 2 = double; 0 = immune for a state. Experience and gold: applied to what defeated monsters give.
help.effects_skill: Skill the player learns for good (on top of those of its class). An item teaching it is not used up when it is already known.
help.state_durationMax: Longer than the duration: each application draws a duration between both (e.g. 20 to 30 s). 0: fixed duration.
help.priority: The player’s state icons are sorted from the highest priority to the lowest.
help.removeOnDamageChance: Chance that a hit taken removes the state (100 = on the first hit).
help.removeAfterSteps: The state goes away once the player walked this many cells (0 = never).
help.state_animationId: Animation played on the target when the state is applied (see the Animations tab).
help.endMessage: Text shown to the player when the state ends, after the character’s name (e.g. “is no longer poisoned.”).
help.traits_skill: Skill known as long as the class, equipment or state carries this trait.
help.traits_chance: Chance (%) that each normal attack that hits adds the state, reduced by the target’s resistance.
help.traits_perSecond: Percentage of max HP or MP restored every second (negative: lost).
help.note: Free notes of the creator: never shown to players, found by the search (Ctrl+F). Tip: a record whose name starts with --- becomes a heading of the list.
help.startItems: What a new character of this class receives. Weapons and armors ticked “worn at start” are equipped at once (the first one of each slot).
help.startItems_equip: Equipped when the character is created, if its slot is still free.
help.skillType: Category shown in the player’s skill window (list of the System tab).
help.successRate: Chance to succeed on each target; a failure counts as a miss.
help.repeats: Times the damage and effects are applied to each target (double, triple attack…).
help.requiredWeaponType: Weapon type the user must hold to use the skill (“none”: any). Monsters do not need one.
help.skill_message: Line written in the chat of nearby players when the skill is used. %1 is replaced by the user’s name (otherwise it is put first). Optional.
help.actions_condition: When the monster may pick this action. An action whose condition does not hold is never drawn.
help.actions_hpBelow: Only possible once the monster’s HP drop below this percentage of its maximum (emergency heal, rage…).
help.actions_stateId: Only possible while the monster is affected by this state.
help.actions_switchId: Only possible if this switch is on for the player being fought (for everyone if it is global).
help.name: Name shown in lists and in game.
help.animation_name: Name to find the animation in the lists.
help.commonEvent_name: Name to find the common event in the lists.
help.description: Text shown to the player in game.
help.icon: Icon of the lists and the game: click the preview or “Choose”.
help.mpCost: Magic points spent on every cast.
help.learnings_level: Level at which the class learns the skill.
help.start_mode: The System start place, or a place of this class.
help.start_mapId: Map where new characters of this class appear.
help.start_x: Column of the start tile (0 = left edge of the map).
help.start_y: Row of the start tile (0 = top edge of the map).
help.startItems_kind: Item, weapon or armor given when the character is created.
help.fps: Frames shown per second: the higher, the faster the animation.
help.sound: Sound played when the animation starts.
help.steps_description: Text of the step, shown in the quest journal.
help.objectives_mapId: Map where the target of the objective is.
help.objectives_eventId: Character or object of the map to talk to.
help.objectives_x: Column of the tile to reach.
help.objectives_y: Row of the tile to reach.
help.objectives_count: Number of monsters to defeat or items to gather.
help.rewardItems_kind: Item, weapon or armor given as a reward.
help.maxPlayers: Maximum number of players in the raid (limited by the System).
help.phases_interval: Seconds between two repeats of the mechanic; 0 = only once.
help.raid_mapId: Map where the raid takes place.

db.imported_quarantined: Database imported. {{count}} script(s) of the common events wait to be reviewed (“Scripts to review” button of the editor).
db.imported_missing_refs: {{count}} entry(ies) point to an entry that does not exist (the game ignores these references, fix them in the editor): {{list}}

summary.never_applied: 0% chance: the state will never be applied.
summary.no_effect: Amount and percentage at 0: the effect does nothing.
summary.missing: This entry no longer exists: choose another one.
summary.no_element: No element chosen: the trait does nothing.
summary.add_skill: Gives the skill “{{name}}” while it is held

rates.none: HP and MP do not change over time.
rates.change: {{stat}}: {{rate}}% of the maximum per second, {{total}}% over {{duration}} s.
rates.change_forever: {{stat}}: {{rate}}% of the maximum per second, until the state is removed.
rates.lethal: Deadly: {{stat}} at {{rate}}% of the maximum per second, the character is knocked out in about {{time}} s (the state lasts {{lasts}}).
rates.drained: {{stat}} at {{rate}}% of the maximum per second: emptied in about {{time}} s (the state lasts {{lasts}}).

db.message_none: No message: the state is applied without telling the player.
db.used_by_none: No entry of the database refers to it.
db.used_by_hint: Entries of the database referring to it (click to open).
db.delete_clean: Also remove the effects, traits and lines of other entries referring to it
db.message_none_end: No end message: the state goes away silently.
db.lists_help: Weapons, armors, skills and classes point to these lines by number: rename them freely, but only the last one can be removed. Line 00 means “none”.
db.skill_message_none: No message: nothing is written in the chat.
db.anim_hint: Actual size compared with a tile: the lit tile is the target.
db.test_enemy_help: Makes this monster appear next to your character, who must be in game. It attacks at once and is gone for good once defeated. Pending changes are saved first.

formula.help: a = the one acting, b = the target. atk attack, def defence, mat magic attack, mdf magic defence, agi agility, luk luck, mhp / mmp max HP and MP, hp / mp current HP and MP. Example: a.atk * 4 - b.def * 2.

bag.title: Bag
bag.discard_how_many: How many “{{name}}” to throw away? (1 to {{max}})
bag.discard_confirm: Throw away {{count}} × {{name}}? They will be lost.

notify.points_taken_back: Lower level: {{count}} parameter point(s) taken back.
notify.battle_no_room: No free room to make the monster appear.
notify.quest_ready: {{name}}: objectives done, go back to the quest giver
notify.chat_help: Commands: /w name message, /r reply, /s map, /p party, /g guild, /me action, /e 1-10 emote, /friend name, /unfriend name, /ignore name, /unignore name, /invite name (party), /leave, /pkick name (remove from the party), /ginvite name (guild), /who
notify.party_kicked: You were removed from the party
notify.guild_kicked: You were removed from the guild
notify.boss_waiting: {{name}} waits for {{count}} players inside before fighting
notify.muted: You cannot write in the chat until {{until}} (UTC)
notify.report_sent: Report about {{name}} sent to the moderators. Thank you.
notify.item_to_bank: Bag full: {{name}} ×{{count}} sent to your bank

mod.unmuted: {{name}} can write in the chat again.

notify.chat_help_staff: Moderation: /kick name [reason], /mute name [duration] [reason], /unmute name, /ban name [duration|perm] [reason], /unban name, /all message (world channel). Duration: 30m, 2h, 7d.

ev.drop_branches_confirm: The branches about to disappear hold commands: they will be deleted. Continue?

page.delete_confirm: Delete page {{n}} and all its commands?
page.nothing_copied: No page copied: use “Copy page” first.
page.limit: An event cannot have more than 20 pages.

ev.list_help: Double click or Enter: edit (or insert on an empty ◆ row). Delete: remove. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V: copy, cut, paste.
ev.conditions_help: The last page whose ticked conditions are all met is shown, for each player according to their own progress.
ev.text_codes: Codes: \P player name, \V[n] variable n, \G currency, \C[n] colour, \I[n] icon, \. and \| pauses, \! wait for a key.
ev.choices_help: One choice per line (6 at most). Each choice gets its own branch in the list.
ev.loop_help: The loop commands repeat until "Break loop".
ev.scope_help: A switch or variable is personal (one per character) or global (shared by the whole server) depending on its declaration in the database (Switches and variables tab).
ev.self_help: Self switches belong to this event and to each character: a chest opened by one player stays closed for the others.
ev.step_help: Step 0: go to the next step.
ev.equip_help: The item must be in the player’s bag; the replaced item goes back to it.
ev.recover_help: Restores all the player’s HP and MP.
ev.inn_help: The player pays the price and recovers all HP and MP (refused without enough gold).
ev.later_shop: The shop window comes with the "Shops" step. Until then, the player sees a message.
ev.battle_help: The monster appears next to the player and attacks at once; it is gone for good once defeated. The player fights freely (the event goes on without waiting).
ev.no_se: No sound imported: add files in the resource manager (se folder).
ev.script_help: JavaScript expression evaluated on the server, in a sandbox (v(n), s(n), self('A'), gold(), level(), item(n)).
ev.script_api: Script run on the server in a sandbox limited to 50 ms. Read: v(n), s(n), self('A'), gold(), level(), item(n), player. Write: setV(n, value), setS(n, true/false), setSelf('A', true/false), notify(text).
ev.json_block_help: This command has no dedicated form: edit it as JSON.

quarantine.approve_help: Turns on the imported scripts of the selected command, once their code is read
quarantine.row: Script from an imported file: it does nothing until it has been read and enabled.
quarantine.none_selected: The selected command holds no script waiting for approval.
quarantine.read_first: This code comes from an imported file. Read it before enabling it: it will then run on the server for every player concerned.

ev.no_music: No file of this kind: import some with the editor’s Resources button.
ev.no_picture: No picture: import some ("Pictures" folder) with the editor’s Resources button.
ev.music_help: "(none)" stops the music or ambience playing. Playing again the one already playing only changes its volume and pitch. Only the player running the event hears it.
ev.me_help: A jingle is played once; the music pauses meanwhile and goes on afterwards.
ev.picture_help: Pictures are shown over the map, to the player running the event; a higher number goes in front. They stay from one map to the next until "Erase a picture". Position in pixels from the top-left corner of the screen.
ev.rotate_help: Positive speed: anticlockwise; 0 stops the rotation.
ev.weather_help: The weather is seen by the player running the event; it stays until the next change. For a weather shared by everyone, use a parallel event on the map.
ev.parallax_help: The new background stays until the player changes map.
ev.scroll_help: Moves the view without moving the player (cutscene). The opposite direction brings it back; it also comes back by itself as soon as the player walks.
ev.transparent_help: Hides the player’s character from its own eyes (the other players still see it). Useful during a cutscene.
ev.timer_help: A timer is shown at the top of the player’s screen and counts down. Test it with a "Timer" condition (for instance ≤ 0:00 in a parallel event).
ev.timer_branch_help: True when the player’s timer runs and the time left matches the comparison.
ev.autorun_warning: ⚠ Autorun: the page starts by itself and repeats endlessly while it is active, and the player cannot move meanwhile. End it by changing a switch (a self switch, for instance) that turns another page on, or the game stays stuck.

quest.none_active: No quest in progress. Look for “!” above characters.
quest.follow_hint: Action: follow on screen or stop following
quest.ready_hint: Go back to the quest giver
quest.abandon_confirm: Abandon “{{name}}”? Its progress will be lost; you can start it again from its giver.

combat.respawn_in: Back to your respawn point in

skills.none: No skill or usable item yet.
skills.help: Tap or click an entry to put it on the hotbar (keys 1 to 8), or drag it onto the bar. ← →: switch tabs. Attack: Action facing an enemy, or F.
skills.help_touch: Tap an entry to put it on a shortcut: the buttons in an arc around A (1-4 / 5-8 switches the page). Attack: A facing an enemy.
skills.none_items: No usable item in the bag.

equip.title: Equipment
equip.nothing: Nothing in the bag for this slot.

shop.title: Shop
shop.nothing_to_sell: You have nothing this merchant buys.

chat.report_prompt: Report {{name}} to the moderators. Reason (insults, cheating, scam…):

friends.title: Friends
friends.name: Character name
friends.nobody_nearby: Nobody else in sight on this map.

trade.title: Trade
trade.bag_empty: Your bag has nothing to trade.
trade.help: Each side locks its offer, then each side confirms. Any change cancels the confirmations.

party.title: Party
party.none: You are not in a party. Invite a player by name.

guild.title: Guild
guild.none: You have no guild. Found your own!
guild.name: Guild name

log.motd: {{who}} changed the message of the day

guild.directory_help: Write to the leader of a guild to ask for an invitation.
guild.directory_empty: No guild yet: found the first one!

admin_panel.title: Administration
admin_panel.new_password: New password (give it to the player): {{password}}
admin_panel.tools_help: First choose the player concerned (among the characters online); “me” is your own character in game.
admin_panel.backup_help: Downloads a complete, consistent copy of the database (accounts, characters, maps, game data).
admin_panel.restore_help: The backup is checked, then replaces the database at the next server restart (the old one is kept next to it, suffix .before-restore).
admin_panel.restore_scheduled: Backup checked: it will be applied at the next server restart.
admin_panel.resources_help: Custom graphics and sounds are imported in the editor (“Resources” button).
admin_panel.rank_locked: This account has a rank equal to or higher than yours: you cannot sanction or disconnect it.
admin_panel.auto_backup_help: Every day, at the chosen hour (server time), a complete copy of the database and of the imported resources is saved on the server. Beyond the chosen duration, the oldest one is replaced. If the server was stopped at that hour, the backup is made as soon as it starts again.
admin_panel.no_server_backup: No automatic backup yet (the first one is made a minute after the server starts).
admin_panel.restore_auto_help: “Restore” prepares the chosen backup: it replaces the database and the resources at the next start of the server (the current files are kept next to them, suffix .before-restore). On the server, npm run restore does the same.
admin_panel.health_help: Green: all is well · orange: server busy · red: the game may slow down.
admin_panel.duration_invalid: Invalid duration: choose a duration or type a number of minutes.
admin_panel.teleport_map_help: Click a light cell to choose where to arrive (dark cells are obstacles).
admin_panel.teleport_blocked: Cell {{x}}, {{y}} is an obstacle: choose a light cell.
admin_panel.need_positive: Type a whole number greater than 0.
admin_panel.no_switch: No switch declared (System tab of the editor)
admin_panel.no_variable: No variable declared (System tab of the editor)
admin_panel.progress_help: Switches and variables drive quests and events: only change them when you know what they control.
admin_panel.announce_mode_banner: Banner at the top of the screen + chat
admin_panel.restore_warning: ⚠ A restoration replaces the WHOLE game (accounts, characters, maps, database) with the state of the backup, at the next start of the server. What was done since is lost, and everybody has to log in again.
admin_panel.confirm_restore_file:
Replace the whole game with the content of “{{name}}” at the next start of the server?
Everything done since this backup will be lost.
admin_panel.restore_password_needed: Type your password to restore a backup.
admin_panel.confirm_restore_backup:
Put the game back as it was on {{when}} at the next start of the server?
Everything done since will be lost.
admin_panel.menu: Menu: account, language, back to the characters
admin_panel.kick_offline: “{{name}}” is not connected: nobody was disconnected.
admin_panel.done_reset_position: “{{name}}” is back at the starting point.
admin_panel.done_invisible_on: You are now invisible to players.
admin_panel.announce_empty: Type the text of the announcement first.
admin_panel.no_account_open: Choose an account in the list to open its sheet.
admin_panel.log_count: {{count}} lines shown — older ones with “Load more”.
admin_panel.log_end: {{count}} lines: the whole log is shown.
admin_panel.new_password_once: Copy it and give it to the player now: it will not be shown again. All the sessions of this account were closed.
admin_panel.copy_failed: The copy did not work: select the password and copy it by hand.
admin_panel.confirm_reset_password: Reset the password of “{{name}}”? The old one will stop working and every session of the account will be closed. The new password is shown once.
admin_panel.confirm_role_player: Make “{{name}}” a player? They lose access to the administration panel.
admin_panel.confirm_role_moderator: Give the role {{role}} to “{{name}}”? They will be able to ban, mute and disconnect players, and to read the logs.
admin_panel.confirm_role_admin: Give the role {{role}} to “{{name}}”? They will have every right: game tools, map editor, database, backups and roles.
admin_panel.confirm_reset_position: Send “{{name}}” back to the starting point? The character leaves the place where it is now.
